author: puffballstudios
title: Artist Call for Abida Comic Line Art Finishing
content:
📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢

Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2

We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel.

What you'll be working on:

○ Finishing and refining line art / inks
○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages
○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches
○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction

You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework. You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels.

If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: slabpixel
title: Paid Illustrator Internship at SlabPixel
content:
Internship Opportunity at SlabPixel (Batch 14)!

SlabPixel is looking for talented Graphic Designer and Illustrator Interns to join our team for a 3-month onsite internship. If you are ready to turn your creative concepts into real projects and grow in a fast-paced creative studio, we want to see your work!

🚨 1x ILLUSTRATOR INTERN
Requirements:
• Distinctive illustration style with strong composition and color skills
• Proficient in illustrator tools
• Able to adapt to different creative directions and brand guidelines
• Consistent and detail-oriented in every illustration set
• Comfortable receiving feedback and working in a team
• Strong illustration portfolio required
Nice to have:
• Experience in character design, mascot development, or icon illustration
• Strong vector illustration skills
• Understanding of animation-ready illustration assets is a plus

📌 INTERNSHIP DETAILS
• Duration: 3 months (Paid Internship)
• Location: Onsite at SlabPixel office

📌 RECRUITMENT TIMELINE
• Open Registration: Oct 28 – Nov 6, 2026
• Screening Announcement: Nov 6, 2026
• Interview Session: Nov 9 – 11, 2026

Submission: https://www.slabpixel.com/careers
